# Architecture

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Actual-state governance

### Decision

Match template-repo's status-gated source-record system: published notes generate README; approved requests generate PRD; accepted decisions generate ARCHITECTURE; active rules generate AGENTS. The generated files are deterministic, committed and never edited separately.

Repository documents describe **only current tracked/observed capabilities**. Implementation designs, API shapes, data schemas, target diagrams and future rules belong only in GitHub issues, not in generated PRD or architectural records.

### Consequences

Every PR with an implementation or governance change updates the affected source records, regenerates all affected outputs, checks their exactness, and labels any unverified external behavior BLOCKED rather than IMPLEMENTED.

_Source: [0001-source-records.md](decisions/0001-source-records.md)_


## Native directories and repository-owned tests

### Decision

Keep independent physical `.github/` and `.agents/` directories, the repository's entire test suite under `.github/tests/`, roles and skills in `.agents/agents/` and `.agents/skills/`, and a pinned upstream `.darkfactory` submodule. Distinguish historical assignment references from diagrams generated from actual source. Proposed implementation diagrams live in issues, not in `.agents/requirements/`.

### Consequences

GitHub Actions remains natively discoverable; there is no mirrored test, workflow, DarkFactory source or speculative API/SQL/JSON authority.

_Source: [0002-layout.md](decisions/0002-layout.md)_


## Actual branch and review controls

### Decision

The repository presently uses `main`, with PRs #331 → #343 → #271 in a GitHub-native dependency stack. Every merge needs independent maintainer review and explicit approval on the final commit. CI is necessary but not sufficient.

### Consequences

The requested future `develop` integration and protected release-only `main` branch migration have **not occurred**. The intended cutover, exact fork-base verification, protected-branch changes and release approval policy are held as unexecuted work in [master issue #348](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/348). Do not represent that target topology as a current GitHub setting.

_Source: [0003-review.md](decisions/0003-review.md)_


## Current version and release implementation

### Decision

`repo.dfconfig` uses DarkFactory PrideVer; no separate tag-only or `VERSION`-file authority should be installed. The committed release workflow currently accepts main pushes and manual dispatch, and can publish development prereleases.

### Consequences

Those current triggers are **not yet compliant** with the separately requested production-promotion policy in [master issue #348](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/348). Their security, branch settings and external side effects must be fixed and verified before cutover. Documentation cannot enforce a policy not yet backed by GitHub/provider configuration.

_Source: [0004-release.md](decisions/0004-release.md)_


## Implemented source boundaries

### Decision

The checked-in legacy Python source under `packages/engine/` owns its app entry point, controller and models; chess and checkers JSON assets live under their respective `packages/` directories. Documentation building and GitHub workflow automation live in `.github/`. Source-derived Mermaid diagrams represent those tracked source declarations.

### Consequences

No client app, FastAPI multiplayer lifecycle, Supabase schema, declarative engine contract, or native distribution is implemented by this governance PR. Proposed application architecture and acceptance criteria are tracked solely in [master issue #348](https://github.com/marius-patrik/BoardGamesWithQuests/issues/348), to be documented in-repo only when corresponding code lands.

_Source: [0005-existing-code.md](decisions/0005-existing-code.md)_
